dedupe_keys.name: photos of buildings taken on october 7th 2017 in san jose canton costa rica

description: The University of Costa Rica Seismic Engineering Laboratory and GFZ-Potsdam provide street photographs of buildings in San José canton and their GPS information. The GFZ Mobile Mapping System captured this release on 7 October 2017. The native description explicitly identifies their use in generating the San José building-exposure model. Coverage: San Jose, Costa Rica; October 7, 2017. Format: 7zip-zipped image/jpg for images; bz2-zipped csv for GPS data. Access: public native descriptive metadata. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The longitude and latitude labels are reversed in this member relative to the collection. No coordinates have been corrected or assumed. Image count, resolution, positioning accuracy and building attributes for this daily member are unstated. The source establishes building-exposure inputs for seismic risk modelling. Related daily releases belong to the same native photograph collection and retain their individual observation dates. Related resources in the native collection have separate identities.
